rechecked_vulnerabilities.reasoning: The withdrawFunds function calls msg.sender.call.value(_weiToWithdraw)() which can be exploited by a malicious contract to re-enter before the function completes, leading to unauthorized withdrawal of funds.
rechecked_vulnerabilities.impact: Users can lose all their deposited ETH due to repeated withdrawal attempts by an attacker.
exploitation_scenario: An attacker deposits funds into the EtherStore contract.
The attacker sends a transaction to execute multiple withdrawFunds calls in quick succession.
During the first call, msg.sender.call.value(_weiToWithdraw)() is executed and the attacker's contract re-enters the withdrawFunds function.
Re-entry allows the attacker to execute additional calls to withdraw before the initial withdrawal completes.
The balance of the user is reduced by the sum of all calls, leaving them with no funds.
rechecked_vulnerabilities.validity_reasoning: Source execution order shows an external interaction before a state update; this violates checks-effects-interactions and supports the reported reentrancy finding.

setup_steps: Fund the target and deploy a re-entering receiver.
execution_steps: Deposit through the receiver, then call withdraw to re-enter before the balance update.
validation_steps: Assert that the receiver withdrew more than its original deposit.
